SELECT u.id, u.avatar, u.name, u.openid, u.phone, u.points, u.time, u.user_type, u.level, u.invite_code, u.birthday, u.balance, u.principal_balance, u.gift_balance, ROUND(IFNULL(pay.consume_amount, 0), 2) AS consume_amount, pay.last_consume_time, IFNULL(inv.invite_count, 0) AS invite_registered_count, IFNULL(cp.coupon_count, 0) AS available_coupon_count
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRIM(ir.inviter_openid) AS inviter_openid, COUNT(1) AS invite_count FROM t_invite_record ir WHERE ir.invitee_openid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ir.invitee_openid) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(ir.inviter_openid) ) inv ON inv.inviter_openid = TRIM(u.openid) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT uc.user_openid, COUNT(1) AS coupon_count FROM t_user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN t_coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.status = 0 AND (uc.expire_time IS NULL OR uc.expire_time > NOW()) AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND (c.end_time IS NULL OR c.end_time >= NOW()) GROUP BY uc.user_openid ) cp ON cp.user_openid = TRIM(u.openid)
ORDER BY IFNULL(pay.consume_amount, 0) ASC, u.id DESC
ORDER BY IFNULL(pay.consume_amount, 0) DESC, u.id DESC
ORDER BY u.id DESC
LIMIT #{p.offset}, #{p.pageSize}
